purpose: Static editorial category illustration, not actual article photography
basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final static editorial category illustration for a dark Korean AI news website, not an actual news photograph. Create ONE single image, landscape 16:9, target 1200x675. Understated refined 3D still life. Deep navy, charcoal, restrained steel blue, low saturation, matte materials, soft broad studio light with visible central form and calm shadow detail. Center-weighted composition safe for edge cropping, simple forms readable as a small thumbnail, no busy background. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, chart axes, UI, icons, people, faces, real brand logos, recognisable actual consumer products, Earth/globe, robots, padlocks, neon or excessive glow. No borders, no collage, no watermark.

conversion.changes: Resize and re-encode only; original generated PNGs retained outside public assets.
